title: Open Shifts Management list
precondition: Logged in as admin@idx.com with OTP 456789; user has Shift read
steps: 1. Open Master Settings 2. Open Shift Management
expected: URL is /shift-management; heading Shifts Management; Total Shifts count is shown

title: List table columns when shifts exist
precondition: SHIFT-NAV-01 and at least one shift exists
expected: Table shows Shift Name; MON; TUE; WED; THU; FRI; SAT; SUN; Actions; search placeholder Search by Shift Name; Manage Column button

title: Empty state when no shifts and no search
expected: Empty state: No shifts added yet; Create and manage daily working hours for your team; Create Shift action

title: Empty search result still shows list chrome
steps: 1. Search a name that does not exist 2. Press Enter
expected: List remains (not the no-shifts empty state); table has zero matching rows or no-results; Total Shifts may stay as full count depending on API

title: Create Shift button is visible with create permission
expected: Primary Create Shift button is visible (data-testid create-new-project-button)

title: Create Shift button is hidden without create permission
expected: Create Shift button is not shown; empty-state Create Shift also hidden if empty
skipReason: Needs a user without Shift create

title: Search by shift name
steps: 1. Type name in Search by Shift Name 2. Press Enter
expected: Matching shift rows are shown; name is title-cased

title: Clear search restores list
expected: Full shift list is shown again

title: Working-day cell shows time range
expected: Cell shows 09:00 AM - 05:00 PM or API formatted start-end

title: Off day cell shows Off
expected: Cell shows Off in muted text

title: Missing day schedule shows dash
expected: Cell shows -
skipReason: Needs a shift with a missing weekday schedule

title: Sort by Shift Name
expected: Rows reorder by name

title: Manage Column shows hidden audit fields
steps: 1. Click Manage Column 2. Enable Created At; Created By; Last Updated At; Last Updated By
expected: Those columns appear; empty createdBy/updatedBy show -

title: Row actions: Edit when edit permission
expected: Edit is shown

title: Row actions: Remove when delete permission
expected: Remove is shown

title: Row actions: Clone when create permission
expected: Clone is shown

title: Actions menu disabled when no row permissions
expected: Actions menu is disabled / not-allowed
skipReason: Needs a row with no edit/create/delete

title: Open Create Shift from list
expected: URL is /shift-management/create; title Create Shift; back arrow; Shift Name; Timezone; Shift Description; Set Timing Per Day; Cancel; Save

title: Open Create Shift from empty state
steps: 1. Click Create Shift on empty state
expected: Same create form as SHIFT-CREATE-01

title: Save disabled until form is valid
steps: 1. Leave Shift Name empty 2. Inspect Save
expected: Save is disabled (shiftName required; isValid false)

title: Shift name required
steps: 1. Focus Shift Name 2. Blur empty 3. Type a valid name
expected: Empty shows Shift name is required; valid name clears error

title: Shift name max 255 characters
expected: Error: Shift name must be at most 255 characters; Save stays disabled

title: Timezone is required and defaults
expected: Timezone has a default value from timezoneOptions; helper if cleared: Timezone is required

title: Change timezone
expected: Selected timezone updates; form is dirty

title: Description is optional
steps: 1. Leave description empty 2. Fill valid name 3. Keep default timings
expected: Save can enable; description not required

title: Description max 255 characters
expected: Error: Description must be at most 255 characters

title: Default timings are 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM Mon-Sun all active
steps: 1. Inspect Set Timing Per Day table
expected: Seven rows Mon-Sun; start 09:00 AM; end 05:00 PM; OFF unchecked; copy icons enabled

title: Create shift happy path
steps: 1. Enter unique name 2. Optional description 3. Keep weekday defaults 4. Click Save
expected: POST /shift succeeds; toast Shift created successfully; navigates to /shift-management; new row is listed

title: Create weekday-only shift (Sat+Sun off)
steps: 1. Unique name 2. Check OFF on Sat and Sun 3. Save
expected: Sat/Sun list cells show Off; Mon-Fri show 09:00-05:00; shift created

title: Create overnight shift (>= 3 hours)
steps: 1. Unique name 2. Set Mon start 09:00 PM end 06:00 AM 3. Save
expected: Overnight duration is valid; shift created

title: Duplicate shift name is rejected
steps: 1. Create another shift with the same name 2. Save
expected: API error toast (Failed to create shift or backend duplicate message); stay on create page

title: Cancel with no changes leaves immediately
expected: Returns to /shift-management; no Unsaved Changes dialog

title: Back arrow with no changes leaves immediately
expected: Returns to /shift-management

title: Unsaved changes dialog on Cancel
steps: 1. Type a shift name 2. Click Cancel
expected: Unsaved Changes dialog; Discard leaves; close/stay keeps form

title: Discard unsaved changes
expected: Navigates to list; new shift is not created

title: Stay on form from unsaved dialog
expected: Still on /shift-management/create; name value kept

title: Invalid start time format
precondition: On create form with name filled
expected: Error: Invalid time format (HH:MM).; Save disabled

title: Start hours must be 1-12
expected: Error: Hours must be between 1 and 12.

title: Start minutes must be 00-59
expected: Error: Minutes must be between 00 and 59.

title: Invalid end time format
steps: 1. Set Monday end time to abc
expected: Error: Invalid time format (HH:MM).

title: End hours must be 1-12
expected: Error: Hours must be between 1 and 12.

title: Start time must be before end time (same clock time)
steps: 1. Set Monday start and end both 09:00 AM
expected: Error: Start time must be before end time.; Save disabled

title: Duration must be at least 3 hours
steps: 1. Set Monday 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM (2 hours)
expected: Error: Shift duration must be at least 3 hours. on end time; Save disabled

title: Exactly 3 hours is valid
steps: 1. Set Monday 09:00 AM to 12:00 PM 2. Unique name 3. Save
expected: No duration error; Save can succeed

title: Mark day OFF disables time inputs and copy
expected: Monday start/end inputs and AM/PM disabled; times reset to 09:00 AM and 05:00 PM; copy icon disabled; tooltip Disabled days cannot be used as source for cloning.

title: Uncheck OFF re-enables timings
expected: Inputs enabled again; copy enabled if times valid

title: All days OFF is invalid
steps: 1. Check OFF on Mon through Sun
expected: At least one day must be active.; Save disabled

title: Copy icon disabled when source timings invalid
steps: 1. Break Monday start time format 2. Hover copy
expected: Copy disabled; tooltip Cannot copy shifts. Source shift has invalid/blank timings.

title: Open copy-to popover from a valid day
expected: Popover Copy timing to; other days listed; Apply disabled until a target is checked

title: Copy excludes source day and OFF days
expected: Sunday not listed; Monday not listed; Tue-Sat listed

title: Apply copy to selected days
steps: 1. Set Monday 10:00 AM-06:00 PM 2. Copy to Tue and Wed 3. Click Apply
expected: Tue and Wed show 10:00 AM and 06:00 PM; popover closes; Apply targets cleared

title: Change AM/PM revalidates duration
steps: 1. Set Monday 09:00 AM-10:00 AM 2. Change end period to PM
expected: 3-hour error clears after 09:00 AM-10:00 PM

title: Open Edit Shift
precondition: List with a shift; edit permission
expected: URL /shift-management/edit/:id; title Edit Shift; name/description/timezone/timings prefilled

title: Edit shows assigned users and metadata
steps: 1. Inspect Assigned Users and Created by / Updated by
expected: Assigned Users count; View Users only if count > 0; Created by and Updated by with timestamps

title: View Users navigates to user list with shift filter
expected: Navigates to user management with shift filter applied

title: View Users hidden when zero assignees
expected: Count 0 users currently assigned to this shift; no View Users button

title: Save disabled in edit until dirty
expected: Save disabled (isEditMode && !isDirty)

title: Save enabled after a change
expected: Save enabled

title: Update shift happy path
expected: PUT /shift/:id succeeds; toast Shift updated successfully; returns to list with new description

title: Saving shows Saving... then Save
expected: Button text Saving... while pending; then navigates away

title: Unsaved guard on edit back
expected: Unsaved Changes dialog; Discard returns to list without saving

title: Clone opens create form with timings copied not name
expected: URL /shift-management/create; title Create Shift; Shift Name and Description empty; timezone and weekly timings copied from source

title: Clone requires a new name then saves
expected: POST /shift creates a new shift; list shows both original and clone

title: Remove opens confirm dialog
expected: Dialog title Remove Shift; Are you sure you want to remove this shift?; Yes I'm sure; cancel

title: Cancel remove keeps the shift
expected: Dialog closes; shift still in list

title: Confirm remove deletes the shift
expected: DELETE /shift/:id; toast Shift removed successfully; row gone; if last shift empty state appears

title: Create route requires Shift create permission
expected: Access denied / redirected; create form not usable
skipReason: Needs a user without Shift create

title: Edit route requires Shift edit or edit-all
expected: Access denied / redirected
skipReason: Needs a user without Shift edit

title: List requires Shift read/read-all/create/edit
expected: Module not in Master Settings or route blocked
skipReason: Needs a user without Shift read
